Yes, NovaLearn should fund the advanced OCR work before accelerating Teams integration. This recommendation is directly supported by current support demand, onboarding impact, and the official roadmap status.

**Current support demand**: The support queue is clogged because 27% of May support tickets were related to import issues and broken citations from scanned PDFs [NL-015#NL-015-S06]. The CTO explicitly describes the OCR pipeline as a "critical system stability requirement" rather than a nice-to-have [NL-015#NL-015-S06].

**Onboarding impact**: Scanned policy documents are the primary driver of citation errors and customer onboarding delays [NL-001#NL-001-S08]. Ingestion of scanned PDFs and permission mapping remain the primary onboarding bottleneck in Q2 2026 [NL-016#NL-016-S01]. The OCR pipeline is scheduled for August 2026 to resolve these issues [NL-001#NL-001-S08].

**Roadmap status**: The official roadmap lists "Accuracy and Grounding" (including scanned legacy documentation) as the primary technical driver of onboarding delays, with Teams integration falling under Enterprise Security and Scaling [NL-014#NL-014-S01]. The OCR pipeline is the top priority for August 2026, while Teams is only in the design phase for Q4 2026, with development slated for early 2027 [NL-015#NL-015-S06]. Product and Engineering leadership explicitly agree that solving the underlying data ingestion and citation problem must come first, and that rushing Teams risks a tenant-isolation breach and would deliver inaccurate, un-cited answers to a larger audience [NL-015#NL-015-S06]. Sales overclaims that Teams is "almost ready" contradict the official roadmap, which states it is still in design [NL-023#NL-023-S04].

Funding and completing OCR first addresses the highest support demand, resolves the core onboarding bottleneck, and adheres to the official roadmap's sequential deployment pipeline (Design, Alpha, Pilot, Public Beta, GA), which requires a secure citation foundation before expanding to new chat interfaces [NL-014#NL-014-S01, NL-015#NL-015-S06].
